spectators.label: Pompadour gang boss
spectators.look: lanky teenage gang boss with a towering glossy black pompadour jutting far forward, narrow scowling eyes and a toothpick in his mouth; ankle-length black high-collar school coat worn open over a red undershirt and a white belly wrap, wide baggy black trousers, wooden geta sandals
spectators.idle: arms crossed, chewing the toothpick, glaring at the ring
spectators.cheer: arms thrown out to the sides, roaring, toothpick flying
spectators.shocked: pompadour sagging, toothpick dropping from his gaping mouth

spectators.label: Biker gang girl with bat
spectators.look: young biker-gang woman with long bleached-blonde hair under a white forehead band, sharp winged eyeliner and a white face mask pulled down to her chin; long purple high-collar gang coat with gold flower embroidery (no lettering) over a white tank top, wide purple pants, black boots, a wooden baseball bat resting on her shoulder
spectators.idle: bat on her shoulder, hip cocked, chewing gum
spectators.shocked: mask slipping off, bat falling, both hands on her cheeks

spectators.label: Green mohawk punk
spectators.look: wiry young punk with a tall spiky lime-green mohawk, shaved sides, several silver ear piercings; torn red plaid shirt with the sleeves ripped off, studded black wristbands, ripped blue jeans hung with silver chains, heavy black boots with yellow laces
spectators.idle: hands in pockets, bobbing his head to a beat
spectators.cheer: both hands up making horn signs, tongue out
spectators.shocked: mohawk wilting to one side, eyes bulging

spectators.label: Pompadour lackey
spectators.look: small skinny delinquent with a brown pompadour too big for his head, buck teeth and tiny black sunglasses; oversized long white school coat dragging at his ankles over a purple shirt, baggy white pants, a rolled-up newspaper in one hand
spectators.idle: slapping the rolled newspaper into his palm, sneering
spectators.cheer: jumping and waving the newspaper overhead
spectators.shocked: sunglasses cracked, cowering behind the newspaper

spectators.label: Yo-yo gang queen
spectators.look: cool teenage girl gang leader with long straight black hair, half-lidded eyes and red lipstick; navy sailor uniform with an ankle-length pleated skirt and a red scarf, white loafers, a shiny silver steel yo-yo on a string
spectators.idle: lazily spinning the silver yo-yo, unimpressed
spectators.cheer: flicking the yo-yo out, smirking with a fist raised
spectators.shocked: yo-yo string tangled around her hand, eyes wide

spectators.label: Flame-helmet rider
spectators.look: biker-gang rider in a white open-face helmet painted with red flames and amber goggles pushed up on it; long white high-collar gang coat with red trim (no lettering), black pants, black riding gloves, a small black-and-white checkered flag
spectators.idle: twisting an imaginary throttle with one hand, flag tucked under his arm
spectators.shocked: goggles snapping down over his eyes, flag drooping

spectators.label: Scarred back-alley punk
spectators.look: broad-shouldered street brawler with a black buzz cut, a long scar across his left cheek and a bandage across his nose; sleeveless black tank top, white tape wrapped around both fists, olive cargo pants, beat-up brown boots
spectators.cheer: arms flexed out to the sides, bellowing
spectators.shocked: stepping back with fists raised, mouth open

spectators.label: Visual-rock guitarist
spectators.look: androgynous rocker with huge teased lavender hair, pale face makeup and dark plum lipstick; black lace choker, long black coat covered in silver buckles, tight black pants, tall platform boots, a red electric guitar slung on his back
spectators.idle: flipping his hair aside, posing coolly
spectators.cheer: head thrown back, playing air guitar on the slung guitar
spectators.shocked: hands pressed to his face, eyeliner running

spectators.label: Skateboard wannabe
spectators.look: round-faced middle-school wannabe delinquent with hair dyed half red and half black, a band-aid on his forehead; black school coat worn open with sleeves rolled up over a white tee, black pants, white sneakers, a green skateboard under his arm
spectators.idle: skateboard under his arm, trying hard to look tough
spectators.cheer: jumping with the skateboard held overhead

spectators.label: Greaser with comb
spectators.look: cocky greaser with a shiny black quiff and long sideburns; black leather jacket with silver zippers over a white t-shirt, cuffed blue jeans, black shoes, a small black pocket comb
spectators.idle: combing his quiff with the pocket comb
spectators.cheer: comb raised, thumbs up and a wink
spectators.shocked: comb snapped in half, quiff collapsed over his face

spectators.label: Gang heavy with meat bun
spectators.look: enormous round gang heavy with a shaved head, a thin mustache and tiny round sunglasses; long purple coat hanging open over a white belly wrap, a thick silver chain around his neck, baggy black pants, a big steaming meat bun in one hand
spectators.cheer: arms spread out to the sides, bun in one hand, laughing
spectators.shocked: bun falling, cheeks puffed out, sunglasses sliding

spectators.label: Bubblegum punk girl
spectators.look: small punk girl with pink twin pigtails, heavy black eyeliner and a studded black choker; oversized sleeveless denim jacket covered in plain round badges, red-and-black plaid skirt over black leggings, chunky combat boots, blowing a big pink bubblegum bubble
spectators.cheer: jumping with both fists up as the bubble pops
spectators.shocked: popped gum stuck on her face, eyes wide

spectators.label: Caped gang captain
spectators.look: theatrical gang captain with wild long white hair tied back with a thick red rope and red painted streaks around his eyes; a torn long black school coat worn over his shoulders like a cape, white undershirt, black hakama-style pants, geta sandals, a single red flower clenched in his teeth
spectators.idle: arms folded, coat-cape fluttering, flower in his teeth
spectators.shocked: flower falling from his mouth, hair standing on end

spectators.label: Tracksuit tough
spectators.look: stocky street tough with shaved sides and a slicked-back top, a heavy gold chain over a shiny maroon tracksuit with white side stripes, white sneakers, cracking sunflower seeds from a paper bag
spectators.idle: one hand in his pocket, spitting sunflower seed shells
spectators.cheer: punching the air with both fists
spectators.shocked: seed bag spilling, leaning back with mouth open

spectators.label: Tanned gyaru with flip phone
spectators.look: deeply tanned party girl with huge voluminous bleached-blonde hair and a big hibiscus clip, white lipstick and white eye makeup; neon pink jacket over a lime top, denim skirt over black leggings, towering platform sandals, a pink flip phone covered in dangling charms
spectators.idle: snapping her flip phone open and shut, bored
spectators.cheer: double peace signs up, tongue out
spectators.shocked: phone dropped, both hands on her cheeks
